notes.title: Bubble Chicken Farm - Update 0.4.0
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Bubble Chicken Farm - Update 0.4.0[/b][/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758781/1c5f6ab865a925230b44ffdb42d8e259d7cecc6f.png[/img]

Get ready, pirates! Bubble Chicken Farm's biggest update is coming, bringing new ways to explore, defend and expand your farm. Check out some of the main new features that will be available in version 0.4.0:

🛩️ New: Glider

- Build your glider and explore the skies! Reach previously inaccessible places and discover hidden treasures.
- Gain momentum by crossing clouds and take advantage of air currents to improve your movement between islands.

🚤 Boat improvements

- Fluid and realistic movement: Now the boat responds more precisely and naturally.
- Capacity for up to 4 players: Get together with your friends and explore the new islands as a group!

🌍 New Islands

- Desert Island: A new village with new missions in an arid biome full of challenges.
- New islands added to the map, full of mysteries and adventures.

🌙 Night Defense

- Hordes of monsters and animals appear at dusk, threatening your farm.
- Set up traps to defend yourself until dawn, when the creatures disappear.

💪 New transportation system

- Carry items and animals: Move objects like boxes and even animals with your bare hands, placing them anywhere, including on your ship.

🐫 Greater variety of animals

- New animals, such as camels and insects, are now part of the world of Bubble Chicken Farm, increasing the diversity of fauna.

🏘️ Vila da Concha Renovated

- The village has undergone a complete overhaul, with more details and new stores, as well as new quests for players.

Coming soon!

These are just some of the new features you'll find in the new Bubble Chicken Farm update 0.4.0. Get ready to explore new horizons, defend your farm and experience new adventures with friends!

notes.title: Next week we'll have the next Bubble Chicken Farm update
New Version 0.3.3 Avaliable Now
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758781/5016b23c2ed99bc489f60fe811b46e2510fc5703.png[/img]

Updates to Version 0.3.3

[b]⦁ New Time and Day Format: We've updated the time and day display in the game.
⦁ Updated Menus: You can now customize your character in the main and lobby menus.
⦁ Improvements and Fixes:
⦁ Network System: We've adjusted the system so that character customizations are saved correctly (remember to update on the server).
⦁ Saving Tools: We've added functions for saving and loading character customizations.
⦁ Lobby Creation: Now checks for saves before creating a lobby.
⦁ Pause Panel: Added a function to fix problems when deleting save data.
⦁ Player Data: New functions for saving and loading character customizations.
⦁ Character Creator: Checks whether you're in the offline or online menu.
⦁ Player Character: Now saves the camera position.
⦁ Fix Save Problems: Save data now correctly corresponds to the current world.
⦁ New Exit Game Button: Added to the main menu to make it easier to exit the game.
⦁ Improvements to the Main Map: We've added ruins and more places to explore.
⦁ Initial Cutscene Bug Fix: Fixed the initial cutscene bug and improved the graphics.[/b]

We thank you all for your continued support and hope you enjoy these improvements! Keep sending us your feedback so that we can make Bubble Chicken Farm better and better.

Happy adventures!

notes.title: Version 0.3.2 Avaliable Now
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758781/3af7e52a22fb69082340297e70733d740721261f.png[/img]

Updates to Version 0.3.2

1. map expansion:
   - We've added new islands for you to explore and discover new secrets.

2. New Monsters:
   - Face new challenges with monsters called "Mordicons". Get ready for epic battles!

3. Improved Fishing:
   - Fishing has been improved to provide a more fun and rewarding experience.

4. Bug Fixes:
   - We have solved several problems related to connecting to and saving the game, ensuring a more stable experience.

5. Cloud Save:
   - It is now possible to save your game progress in the cloud, allowing you to access your progress from anywhere
6. Improved Graphics:
   - We've improved the graphic quality of the water, as well as enhancing the shadow and light reflections, making the game even more beautiful.

7. Performance Optimization:
   - We've optimized the game's performance so that it runs better on computers with more modest specifications.

We thank you all for your continued support and hope you enjoy these improvements! Keep sending us your feedback so that we can make Bubble Chicken Farm better and better.

Happy adventures!

notes.title: Version 0.3.1 Update
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758781/3affb030ade26a3279a7596885e55c035e2c99da.png[/img]

Updates to Version 0.3.1
⦁ English Cutscene Dubbing: The cutscene is now available with English dubbing.
⦁ Adjustment to the Transition Time from Cutscene to Gameplay: Improvements to the transition time for a more fluid experience.
⦁ Improved Interactivity: It is now possible to get out of the chair with a click of the mouse.
⦁ Interface Bug Fix: Fixed the bug that caused the entire interface to disappear when opening the settings screen.
⦁ Steam Achievements: Added achievements to challenge players on the Steam platform.
⦁ Translation revision: The English and Portuguese translations have been revised for greater accuracy and clarity.
⦁ Minimap bug fixed: Problem that caused the minimap to disappear when opening the inventory has been fixed.
⦁ Adjustment to Fishing Difficulty: Adjustments have been made to improve the fishing experience in the game.
⦁ Variety of Plant Destruction Tools: It is now possible to destroy crops with a wider variety of tools.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44758781/59a31de48ca6016c8ee1c27c46eff03bc45978ce.png[/img]
